page.title: Scan barcode
page.subtitle: Package nutrition from the JoyoRogo product database.

camera.preview: Camera preview for reading a barcode
camera.aim: Point the camera at the barcode on the package
camera.privacyWeb: Images are processed in your browser and never sent.
camera.privacyNative: JoyoRogo needs camera access to read package barcodes. Barcodes are read on your device; the photo is never sent anywhere.
camera.unsupported: Camera isn't available in this browser.
camera.unsupportedDetail: This browser can't read barcodes with the camera yet (Chrome on Android can). Type the number printed under the barcode, or use the JoyoRogo app on your phone.

error.denied: Camera access was denied. Allow it in your browser settings, or type the number.
error.failed: Couldn't open the camera. Type the barcode number below.

entry.invalid: That barcode number isn't valid. Check the digits (8, 12 or 13).

notFound.title: Not in the database yet
notFound.body: Barcode {{code}} isn't listed yet. Photograph its nutrition label and the numbers are saved for every JoyoRogo user.

incomplete.body: {{reason}} Photograph the nutrition label to complete it, or enter the calories yourself.

reason.no_kcal: This product has no calorie data yet.
reason.implausible: The recorded nutrition numbers look off, so we don't use them.

fallback.photoNote: The AI estimates from the photo; it doesn't read the label numbers. If you have the label numbers, enter them yourself.
fallback.label: Photograph the nutrition label
fallback.labelNote: Just photograph the "Informasi Nilai Gizi" table on the pack. The numbers are read automatically, you check them, then they're saved for every user.

result.missing: No {{fields}} data for this product; missing values are logged as unknown, not zero.

sources.off: Source: Open Food Facts, a community database. Numbers may differ from your package label; double-check if unsure.
sources.labelPhoto: Source: a package label photographed by one JoyoRogo user. Nobody has confirmed it yet, so compare it with your package.
sources.labelPhotoConfirmed: Source: package label photographed by JoyoRogo users, confirmed by {{count}} people.
sources.other: Source: {{source}}. Numbers may differ from your package label; double-check if unsure.
sources.offLink: View this product on Open Food Facts

community.prompt: These numbers come from another user. Do they match the pack in your hand?
community.confirmed: Thanks for checking. These numbers are now confirmed by {{count}} users.
community.outvoted: Thanks. These numbers are already confirmed by other users, so your check didn't change them.

errors.invalidCode: That barcode isn't valid. Check the digits (8, 12 or 13).
errors.sourcesUnavailable: Can't reach the product database right now. Try again shortly or enter it by hand.
errors.implausible: Those numbers can't be right (over 900 kcal, or over 100 g per 100 g). Check them, especially "per serving" versus "per 100".
errors.energyMismatch: The energy doesn't match the protein, carbohydrate and fat. Check the numbers, or save anyway if the label really says so.
errors.servingRequired: Enter the serving size so the numbers can be converted to per 100.
errors.nameInvalid: That product name isn't valid. Use the name printed on the pack, without links.
errors.alreadyKnown: This product already has complete nutrition data, so no photo is needed.
errors.contributionLimit: You've reached today's limit for adding products. Try again tomorrow.
errors.notConfirmable: This product can't be confirmed yet.
errors.aiUnavailable: The label reader isn't available right now. Enter the numbers yourself.
errors.labelLimit: You've used today's {{count}} label photos. Enter the numbers yourself or try again tomorrow.
errors.labelUnclear: The label wasn't readable. Retake it closer and without glare, or enter the numbers yourself.
errors.labelNotLabel: That doesn't look like an "Informasi Nilai Gizi" table. Photograph the table, or enter the numbers yourself.
errors.labelTimeout: Reading the label took too long. Try again, or enter the numbers yourself.
errors.labelFailed: The label couldn't be read. Try again, or enter the numbers yourself.

label.title: Nutrition label photo
label.intro: Photograph the "Informasi Nilai Gizi" table on the pack. The numbers are read automatically; you check them before saving.
label.privacy: The photo is only read, then deleted. Only the name and nutrition numbers are saved, shared with every JoyoRogo user.

permission.title: Camera for the label photo
permission.body: JoyoRogo needs the camera to photograph the nutrition table on the pack. The photo is sent once to be read, then deleted.
permission.denied: Camera access was denied. Open your phone settings to allow it, or pick a photo from your gallery.

capture.label: Nutrition table photo
capture.labelHint: Make sure the "Informasi Nilai Gizi" table is clear and free of glare.
capture.frontHint: Optional, fills in the name and brand for you.

form.title: Check the numbers
form.hint: Compare with the label on the pack. Fix anything that was misread.
form.name: Product name
form.servingRequired: Enter the serving size, or switch to "per 100" if the label uses that.

warning.no_serving_size: The serving size couldn't be read. Fill it in from the label.
warning.no_energy: The total energy couldn't be read. Fill it in from the label.
warning.columns_disagree: The "per serving" and "per 100" columns don't match. Check which one you copied.
warning.energy_mismatch: The energy doesn't match the protein, carbohydrate and fat. Check the numbers.
warning.implausible: These numbers can't be right. Check them, including "per serving" versus "per 100".

thanks.title: Thank you!
thanks.saved: Thanks, now every JoyoRogo user can scan this product.
thanks.confirmed: Thanks, your numbers match another user's. This product is now confirmed by {{count}} people and every JoyoRogo user can scan it.
thanks.outvoted: Thanks. Your numbers differ from what other users confirmed, so they aren't used yet. If more people agree with you, they will replace the current ones.
